label: Same-source exercise controls separate actual path credit from productive supply
paraphrase: All three named interpretations have coherent nonempty exercised records, one necessary source, the same contingent recipient, operation and adoption borne by the same source, actual contributor paths in both directions between adoption and product, path credit from source to recipient, and local existential-token coverage and B2 through the stated path-credit adapter. The source operation does not scenario-suffice for adoption or product. The circular route and the route admitting but not exercising a source-only alternative lack Supply. Exercising that alternative supplies adoption and product while retaining the circular alternative. Alternatively accepting adoption as independently supplied yields product Supply on the original event carrier. These are finite structural controls; they prove no rational guidance, real esse efficacy, explanatory adequacy, compatibility with strong simplicity or metaphysical possibility.
